title: High-Performance Substrate — Dependency Doctrine & Implementation Plan

promoted_for_implementation.dependency: none — DuckDB already provides Parquet support
promoted_for_implementation.runtime_vs_dev: both (DuckDB is runtime dependency; compaction scripts are dev/operator)
promoted_for_implementation.optional_extra: none — DuckDB is a core dependency
promoted_for_implementation.why_existing_insufficient: N/A — already in use. Formalizing the existing pattern.
promoted_for_implementation.security_privacy: Parquet snapshots are derived analytical artifacts. Canonical JSONL remains source-of-truth. Content-light enforcement applies to Parquet generation.
promoted_for_implementation.license: MIT (DuckDB) — Parquet format is Apache 2.0 but format-only
promoted_for_implementation.fallback: Parquet compaction is optional. JSONL remains canonical.

promoted_for_implementation.dependency: psycopg[binary]>=3.2 (already recommended in Postgres audit, Phase 3)
promoted_for_implementation.optional_extra: none — core dependency when Postgres DSN is configured
promoted_for_implementation.why_existing_insufficient: No existing Postgres connectivity. pg8000 or other drivers lack COPY protocol support. psycopg 3 is the strategic Postgres driver.
promoted_for_implementation.security_privacy: COPY must use staging tables with constraint validation. Never COPY directly to operational tables. Connection uses scram-sha-256 authentication.
promoted_for_implementation.transitive_risk: low — single-purpose driver. Well-maintained by Postgres core team.
promoted_for_implementation.ci_impact: CI must have Postgres available for integration tests (docker-compose or service container). Tests marked @pytest.mark.postgres skip if no DSN.
promoted_for_implementation.fallback: Local mode (no Postgres DSN) does not require psycopg. Import is optional/lazy.

promoted_for_implementation.runtime_vs_dev: both — used in session lifecycle (runtime) and compaction/archive scripts (dev/operator)
promoted_for_implementation.why_existing_insufficient: Zstandard is already present but underused — only teleport diff compression. Expanding usage costs nothing.
promoted_for_implementation.security_privacy: Compression does not obscure content-light inspection — decompressed data must pass redaction scan. Compression is storage optimization, not redaction.
promoted_for_implementation.fallback: gzip remains as fallback for environments where zstandard is unavailable (should not occur — zstandard is a core dependency).

promoted_for_implementation.why_existing_insufficient: Pydantic is present but underused — many modules use stdlib json.loads/dumps instead of model_validate/model_dump_json. Expanding Pydantic usage replaces untyped dicts with typed models at module boundaries.
promoted_for_implementation.security_privacy: Pydantic models enforce content-light by construction — field-level type validation and extra='forbid' prevent unknown fields from leaking into storage.
promoted_for_implementation.fallback: N/A — Pydantic is a hard dependency.

prototype_candidates.why_existing_insufficient: No existing in-memory columnar interchange. Dict-of-dicts is the current projection payload format. Arrow provides zero-copy interchange between subsystems.
prototype_candidates.security_privacy: Arrow is in-memory only — never persisted. Content-light enforcement applies to Arrow table construction.
prototype_candidates.transitive_risk: low-medium — ~50MB wheel. Well-maintained. Used by pandas, Polars, DuckDB.
prototype_candidates.ci_impact: CI must install 'rig-relay[arrow]' extra. Tests marked @pytest.mark.arrow skip if pyarrow not installed.
prototype_candidates.packaging_impact: ~50MB additional wheel size. Optional extra — not installed by default.
prototype_candidates.fallback: Arrow conversion failure falls back to dict-of-dicts. pyarrow is an optional extra.

parked: ADBC / Arrow Flight — premature before Postgres ports. Audit later.
Polars — DuckDB dominates. Evaluate after Phase 4 if measured bottlenecks exist.
Ibis — raw SQL + contract tests clearer for 2 backends. Evaluate if backend count grows.
pgvector — Phase 6 audit. Requires Postgres + sensitive-derived-data policy.
pg_jsonschema — Phase 5 defense-in-depth. Application-level jsonschema remains primary.
pgmq — SKIP LOCKED sufficient for lease cleanup. Full pgmq is overkill.
orjson — no measured JSON bottleneck. Evaluate after Phase 1 measurement harness.
SQLGlot — Phase 7 linting/validation. Do not auto-transpile.
rejected: msgspec — Pydantic v2 + pydantic-core already provides Rust-backed serialization.
Iceberg / Delta — wrong scale for local-first architecture.
LanceDB — fragments Postgres operational authority. pgvector inside Postgres is preferred.
SQLite — forbidden per existing architecture policy.

phase_dependency_additions.phase_1: zero new dependencies. Expand Zstandard usage and Pydantic exploitation — no new packages.
phase_dependency_additions.phase_2: zero new dependencies. Port definitions are pure Python protocols. File-backed adapters use existing stdlib + pydantic + pathlib.
phase_dependency_additions.phase_3: uv add 'psycopg[binary]>=3.2'. Optionally uv add 'pyarrow>=19.0' as [arrow] extra.
phase_dependency_additions.phase_5: zero new dependencies. pg_jsonschema is a Postgres extension, not a Python dependency.
phase_dependency_additions.phase_6: pgvector Python client if semantic retrieval is promoted from park to prototype.
phase_dependency_additions.phase_7: SQLGlot if linting/validation need is proven.
phase_dependency_additions.phase_8: zero new dependencies — park candidates only.
